items.value: Billing, POS and portals built around how your business actually runs.
When ready made apps do not fit, you end up keeping a register beside them. We build billing, POS and portal software around how your business already works. Then we make it run on a phone.
Custom POS and tailoring dashboard built by Digitorium for Classic Exclusive
Shops, traders, forwarders and service firms
Registers, Excel files and notes on WhatsApp
Your business already has a system. It lives in registers, Excel files and somebody's memory. We turn it into software, without changing how you work.
Bills that match how you sell. Fabric by the metre and a stitched garment on one bill, for example. Print or send on WhatsApp in one action.
Quotations, invoices, bills of lading and statements, created as clean PDFs and ready to send from a phone.
Enter a customer, a party or a measurement once, then reuse it everywhere. Search by name or mobile.
Inventory with low stock alerts. Every job stage tracked, so nothing sits forgotten on a slip.
Separate logins by role. Staff do their work without seeing the accounts.
Today's sales, pending work and what is owed, on one screen instead of four registers.
Have a process that lives on paper?
Built from scratch, used every day
A fabric and tailoring shop ran on registers and slips. Now billing, measurements, the tailoring pipeline and stock sit in one system.
Bill for fabric and stitching together
A freight forwarder ran every quote, invoice and bill of lading out of Excel. Now documents go out from a phone, minutes after the conversation.
Super optimised. We can create a document and send it to a customer straight from the phone.
We look at how the job is done today, registers and all. The software follows that, not the other way round.
Every module listed with what it does. You approve it before we build anything.
You use the first parts early, so problems show up while they are cheap to fix.
We help move your records in and show the team how it works.
Tell us what you run on today.
Why not use a ready made app?
Ready made apps are cheaper and faster if your business fits them. When it does not, you end up keeping a register beside the software anyway, which is the problem you were solving.
Does it work on a phone?
Yes. The Devi Logistics portal runs properly on phone and tablet, so a quote or an invoice can be created and sent away from the office.
Can staff use it without seeing the accounts?
Yes. Access is role based. A counter user can bill and look up customers while revenue reports stay with the owner.
It depends on the modules. We scope it in writing after seeing how you work, with each module listed line by line.
Can you work with a business outside India?
Yes. Devi Logistics is in Canada. The whole project ran over calls and WhatsApp.
Spreadsheets got you here. They will not get you further.
Show us the parts of your business that still live on paper. We will tell you what software would fix, and what it would not.
Hi Digitorium, I want to talk about custom software for my business.
